verdict.rationale: HeyGen's docs say Photo Avatars animate the face and sync lip movements to your script (heygen-docs-13). Avatar speech underpins the cinematic avatar videos, AI actors and digital twins with voice (heygen-docs-18, heygen-docs-19, heygen-docs-20). Its AI dubbing with lip sync drew independent praise for realism on the Milei speech (heygen-docs-23, heygen-comm-1). missing for 10: explicit documentation of lip-syncing to a creator's own uploaded audio track (evidence covers script/TTS and dubbing), evidence of multi-character dialogue scenes.
